description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Valene Health is hiring an early-career full-stack engineer to build production applications and services for its AI-powered clinical automation platform. The role develops web features, backend APIs, patient and clinical workflows, and integrations with AI agent workflows from design through deployment.
Full Stack Engineer building Next.js applications and Node.js APIs for patient enrollment, medical-event workflows, and PostgreSQL data models

Responsibilities:
• Build and ship features across our web application (Next.js) and backend APIs (Node.js, NestJS)
• Develop workflows for patient enrollment, medical events, AI agent configuration, and staff-facing summaries, alerts, and tasks
• Design, maintain, and query PostgreSQL data models for organizations, departments, agents, patients, events, and calls
• Help transform procedure and discharge PDFs into structured patient information and implement rule-based call scheduling
• Collaborate with product and AI engineering to connect customer-facing experiences with underlying agent workflows
• Write automated tests, participate in pull-request reviews, troubleshoot issues, and take ownership of features through production

Requirements:
• Hands-on experience building software using Node.js and TypeScript, through professional work, internships, coursework, or substantial personal projects
• Experience with a modern frontend framework, preferably React or Next.js
• Working knowledge of relational databases, SQL, and data modeling; PostgreSQL is our primary database
• Familiarity with Git, GitHub, pull requests, and collaborative development practices
• An engineering mindset that values testing, reliability, maintainability, and end-to-end ownership
• Clear written communication and a willingness to learn in a fast-moving startup environment

Preferred:
• NestJS or production API development
• Cloud infrastructure, particularly Microsoft Azure
• Telephony platforms such as Twilio or Telnyx
• Healthcare interoperability, including FHIR, HL7, or EHR APIs such as Epic and athenahealth
• Background processing, queues, job scheduling, or multi-tenant applications
